fields.Name: Every flame in the area turns green and points toward the same distant ruin for one minute.
fields.Description: Every flame in the area turns green and points toward the same distant ruin for one minute.

fields.Name: A terrified courier mistakes a party member for their contact and hands over a sealed royal confession.
fields.Description: A terrified courier mistakes a party member for their contact and hands over a sealed royal confession.

fields.Name: A localized rainstorm follows one character while the sky remains clear everywhere else.
fields.Description: A localized rainstorm follows one character while the sky remains clear everywhere else.

fields.Name: Two merchants begin an escalating auction for an ordinary item carried by the party, refusing to explain why.
fields.Description: Two merchants begin an escalating auction for an ordinary item carried by the party, refusing to explain why.

fields.Name: A wounded monster crashes into the scene, fleeing from something far more dangerous just out of sight.
fields.Description: A wounded monster crashes into the scene, fleeing from something far more dangerous just out of sight.

fields.Name: All spoken lies become visible as black smoke until sunset, causing immediate panic in the nearest settlement.
fields.Description: All spoken lies become visible as black smoke until sunset, causing immediate panic in the nearest settlement.

fields.Name: A festival starts unexpectedly; its central competition recreates a recent party achievement with wildly incorrect details.
fields.Description: A festival starts unexpectedly; its central competition recreates a recent party achievement with wildly incorrect details.

fields.Name: An earthquake opens a stairway beneath the road and seals the path ahead.
fields.Description: An earthquake opens a stairway beneath the road and seals the path ahead.

fields.Name: A child calmly asks the party to remove the ghost living under their bed; the ghost claims the child is the haunting.
fields.Description: A child calmly asks the party to remove the ghost living under their bed; the ghost claims the child is the haunting.

fields.Name: A shower of tiny harmless frogs falls from a cloudless sky, each bearing the same golden rune.
fields.Description: A shower of tiny harmless frogs falls from a cloudless sky, each bearing the same golden rune.

fields.Name: The party encounters their own wanted posters, issued tomorrow and accusing them of a crime that has not happened yet.
fields.Description: The party encounters their own wanted posters, issued tomorrow and accusing them of a crime that has not happened yet.

fields.Name: A nearby statue turns its head and whispers a warning to the character with the lowest perception.
fields.Description: A nearby statue turns its head and whispers a warning to the character with the lowest perception.

fields.Name: A caravan offers safe passage, but every traveler insists they have always known one of the heroes.
fields.Description: A caravan offers safe passage, but every traveler insists they have always known one of the heroes.

fields.Name: For one hour, shadows detach from their owners and act out their owners' hidden intentions.
fields.Description: For one hour, shadows detach from their owners and act out their owners' hidden intentions.

fields.Name: A bridge collapses after the party crosses, separating them from pursuing enemies and their easiest route home.
fields.Description: A bridge collapses after the party crosses, separating them from pursuing enemies and their easiest route home.

fields.Name: A magical market appears between two trees and will vanish after exactly thirteen purchases.
fields.Description: A magical market appears between two trees and will vanish after exactly thirteen purchases.

fields.Name: A dying raven delivers a signet ring and repeats a place name no map records.
fields.Description: A dying raven delivers a signet ring and repeats a place name no map records.

fields.Name: An eclipse begins years ahead of schedule; magical powers behave in reversed or symbolic ways.
fields.Description: An eclipse begins years ahead of schedule; magical powers behave in reversed or symbolic ways.

fields.Name: A noble procession blocks the road while masked rebels prepare an ambush from both sides.
fields.Description: A noble procession blocks the road while masked rebels prepare an ambush from both sides.

fields.Name: The nearest river runs backward, exposing a wreck full of sealed cargo and awakening its drowned crew.
fields.Description: The nearest river runs backward, exposing a wreck full of sealed cargo and awakening its drowned crew.

fields.Name: A famous adventurer publicly credits the party for a deed they did not do and asks them to maintain the story.
fields.Description: A famous adventurer publicly credits the party for a deed they did not do and asks them to maintain the story.

fields.Name: Everyone in a village has fallen asleep except one deeply suspicious baker.
fields.Description: Everyone in a village has fallen asleep except one deeply suspicious baker.

fields.Name: A wandering judge declares an improvised trial over ownership of a talking sword that chose a party member.
fields.Description: A wandering judge declares an improvised trial over ownership of a talking sword that chose a party member.

fields.Name: A harmless animal begins speaking with the voice of an absent ally and asks for urgent help.
fields.Description: A harmless animal begins speaking with the voice of an absent ally and asks for urgent help.

fields.Name: The moon briefly shows a second face, after which every compass points toward the party.
fields.Description: The moon briefly shows a second face, after which every compass points toward the party.

fields.Name: A battlefield from the distant past overlays the present landscape, and ghostly actions cause real damage.
fields.Description: A battlefield from the distant past overlays the present landscape, and ghostly actions cause real damage.

fields.Name: A thief steals something trivial but leaves behind an item far more valuable and dangerously recognizable.
fields.Description: A thief steals something trivial but leaves behind an item far more valuable and dangerously recognizable.

fields.Name: A bell rings underground; local elders insist there is no bell and order everyone indoors.
fields.Description: A bell rings underground; local elders insist there is no bell and order everyone indoors.

fields.Name: A spontaneous peace negotiation begins between two hostile factions, and both choose the party as neutral witnesses.
fields.Description: A spontaneous peace negotiation begins between two hostile factions, and both choose the party as neutral witnesses.

fields.Name: Time skips forward three hours for everyone except the party, who are now blamed for what happened during the gap.
fields.Description: Time skips forward three hours for everyone except the party, who are now blamed for what happened during the gap.

fields.Name: Sudden Tremor
fields.Description: The ground shakes hard enough to interrupt events and reveal a fissure, passage, or weakened structure.

fields.Name: Panicked Animals
fields.Description: Cries draw nearer as wildlife flees a threat that is still unseen.

fields.Name: Distress Call
fields.Description: A voice calls for help from a place where nobody should survive.

fields.Name: Nauseating Odor
fields.Description: An unusual stench fills the area, leading toward its source while warning of danger.

fields.Name: Bewitching Perfume
fields.Description: A pleasant scent subtly alters the attention, emotions, or behavior of those exposed.

fields.Name: Shared Pain
fields.Description: Several people feel the same pain at once without visible injury.

fields.Name: Fainting
fields.Description: A background character loses consciousness just before revealing essential information.

fields.Name: Gathering Storm
fields.Description: The weather changes abruptly, complicating travel, combat, or communication.

fields.Name: Unexpected Arrival
fields.Description: A newcomer appears and claims to have known one of the characters for years.

fields.Name: Hostile Migration
fields.Description: Several creatures enter the area after a greater threat drives them from their territory.

fields.Name: Disrupted Cycle
fields.Description: Night falls or day breaks hours too early, while clocks and memories disagree.

fields.Name: Impossible Message
fields.Description: A call for help comes from someone absent, dead, or impossibly far away.

fields.Name: Return of the Past
fields.Description: A character’s history returns as a witness, debt, or accusation.

fields.Name: Sudden Epidemic
fields.Description: A group member shows the first signs of a disease the locals recognize with terror.

fields.Name: Supplies Exhausted
fields.Description: Food disappears, spoils, or becomes inedible at the worst moment.

fields.Name: Extreme Temperature
fields.Description: Abnormal heat or cold forces everyone to seek shelter or an explanation quickly.
